title: Just a Editable Game Title
description: Set any game title and icon, as you wish
body:
**Just a Editable Game Title** Just allows you to set a game title and icon to whatever you want, that's it

![Game Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e70ef867cac74ab04d02416ae592fbab34f412cd.png)

The mod can also have placeholders to get either:
- It's current version (`${version}`)
- Your username (`${username}`)
- Or the Current Mode (Multiplayer, Singleplayer) (`${mode}`)

For setting a icon, icons go to your `.minecraft` folder under a `icons` folder (*Icons must be .png!*) then on the config you give the name to that file (without its extension)
